# scm_cngfw_ngfirewall_list (Data Source)

Retrieves a listing of config items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scm_cngfw_ngfirewall_list" "list_example" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

# Environment variable to pick AWS region from the environment.
variable "aws_region" {
  type        = string
  description = "The AWS region where the firewall is deployed (e.g. us-east-1)."
}

output "ngfirewall" {
  description = "The Cloud NGFW firewall list."
  value       = data.scm_cngfw_ngfirewall_list.list_example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) The AWS region where the Cloud NGFW firewall is deployed

### Optional

- `globalrulestackname` (String) Name of the global rulestack to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `firewalls_describe` (Attributes List) List of firewalls_describe items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewalls_describe))
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `total` (Number) The total number of items.
